tokenHelp.message: Copy it from marks, in Settings > Browser extension. Each profile has its own.

blockedIn.message: The page asks for verification: complete it and save again ($PROFILE$ profile).

error_origin.message: The request doesn't come from the extension.

error_token.message: The token is missing or not valid.

error_too_large.message: The page is too large to save.

error_unsupported_scheme.message: Only http and https URLs can be saved.
